# Caddy — load-balancer-sse

Two backends with sticky sessions, PUSH over Server-Sent Events. Affinity has to hold both for the EventSource GET and for the separate client-to-server POSTs, and an upgrade is refused with 501.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

Caddy site block (`caddy/http/load-balancer-sse/vaadin.caddyfile`), mounted as
`/etc/caddy/vaadin.caddyfile`:

```caddyfile
# Two backends with sticky sessions, PUSH over Server-Sent Events.
#
# load-balancer/vaadin.caddyfile plus the refusal from
# templates/passthrough-sse.caddyfile. Affinity has to hold both for the
# EventSource GET and for the separate client-to-server POSTs; the ROUTEID
# cookie covers both, since the browser sends it on each.
:80 {
	import common

	@upgrade header Upgrade *
	respond @upgrade 501

	reverse_proxy vaadin-1:8080 vaadin-2:8080 {
		lb_policy cookie ROUTEID
	}
}
```

The global options and the `common` snippet this file imports (the
access log and the compression allowlist) come from the shared
[Caddyfile](../../Caddyfile), mounted read-only over the image's own
`/etc/caddy/Caddyfile`. It imports this file, so the two only load as a pair.
